title: representation.registered payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `representation.registered`. Carries the enumerated authorities the mandate grants, so a consumer can tell that a representative may receive service but may not settle - without learning who either party is. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
